settings.title: Settings
settings.preset.default.hint: Tidies templates, tables, section headings, lists, links and the page footer.
settings.preset.production.hint: All Default rules, plus references, external links and spacing around section headings. Interlanguage links are moved to the footer.
settings.format-templates.hint: Lays out template calls and replaces underscores in template names with spaces.
settings.line-width.hint: A template call on its own line stays on one line if it fits within this many characters. Otherwise each parameter is placed on its own line.
settings.inline-spacing.hint: Auto uses whichever spacing fits within the line width.
settings.format-tables.hint: Tidies table, row and cell markup.
settings.cell-separator.hint: Keep as written corrects spacing. Auto and One per line place each cell on its own line.
settings.headings.hint: Places one space inside the == markers.
settings.lists.hint: Places one space after list markers such as * and #.
settings.section-spacing.hint: Inserts a blank line between a section heading and adjacent content.
settings.normalize-blank-lines.hint: Reduces three or more consecutive blank lines to two.
settings.html-void-tags.hint:
How
,
and are written when they have no attributes.
settings.wikilinks.hint: Replaces underscores in link targets with spaces.
settings.external-links.hint: Corrects spacing in labelled external links on their own line.
settings.file-links.hint: Tidies file links on their own line.
settings.redirects.hint: Tidies a #REDIRECT on the first line.
settings.categories.hint: Tidies category and DEFAULTSORT lines in the footer.
settings.behavior-switches.hint: Tidies magic words such as __NOTOC__ on their own line.
settings.interlanguage-prefixes.hint: Comma-separated. Links with these prefixes are treated as interlanguage links.
settings.font-family.hint: A CSS font-family list, such as "Fira Code", monospace.
settings.font-features.hint: A CSS font-feature-settings value, such as "ss01", "zero".
settings.level.hint:
Runs rules up to this level. Safe only covers section headings, blank lines and
and similar tags.
settings.reset-all.title: Also resets theme, language and line wrapping
